title: Death Siphon (not cast by Velox / Lagopus)
problem: Same as Dark Ritual: it gives the caster stats but is filed as UTILITY, so Velox and Lagopus never cast it.
notes: Text: Velox / Lagopus: "... first 3 permanent, stat-manipulating Spell Gems each have a 50% / 20% chance to be {ACTION_cast} automatically at the start of battle." | Death Siphon: ... Evidence: Spell DB field 4 of id 37 = "UTILITY" (store @0x1458d9aa5); bc_StartupCasting L153 / L293 as #8. Fix sketch: Same hook as B3#8 (one hook covers ids 35 and 37). Reasoning: Identical to #8; ship as one record with #8. App note (unpatched game): Velox and Lagopus never cast Death Siphon, because the game files it as a utility spell even though it gives stats. Source: errata round 2 (2026-10-26). | Patch (batch L): flag patch; the SU-0228 hook also accepts spell 37 when this patch is on. Needs SU-0228.

release_notes.effect: Velox and Lagopus (traits) with Death Siphon
release_notes.intended: The first 3 permanent, stat-manipulating Spell Gems have a chance to be cast at the start of battle.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, Death Siphon was never picked although it gives the caster stats, because the game files it as a utility spell.
release_notes.fix: Now Death Siphon counts as a stat-manipulating Spell Gem for Velox and Lagopus.
